tools.name: calculate_paycheck
tools.description: Estimate 2026 take-home pay for one paycheck in California, New York, Illinois, Texas, or Florida. Federal income tax, Social Security, Medicare, and that state's withholding use the same figures as auracalcs.com. Returns the paycheck lines, a link to the matching page, the publications and the date

tools.name: convert_hourly_to_salary
tools.description: Convert an hourly wage into gross annual, monthly, semimonthly, biweekly, weekly, and daily pay, including overtime. Uses the same formula as the AuraCalcs hourly to salary page. This is gross pay before tax. Estimate only.
